WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
               ORDER BY fd.d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN filtered_dates AS fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
               ORDER BY fd.d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN filtered_dates AS fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fd.d_date
)
SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, web_cumulative, store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, web_cumulative, store_cumulative
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk,
               d_date,
               web_sales,
               store_sales,
               MAX(web_sales) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY item_sk
                   ORDER BY d_date
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
               ) AS web_cumulative,
               MAX(store_sales) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY item_sk
                   ORDER BY d_date
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
               ) AS store_cumulative
        FROM (
            SELECT COALESCE(web.item_sk, store.item_sk) AS item_sk,
                   COALESCE(web.d_date, store.d_date) AS d_date,
                   web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
                   store.cume_sales AS store_sales
            FROM (
                SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM web_v1
                UNION
                SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM store_v1
            ) AS p
            LEFT JOIN web_v1 AS web ON p.item_sk = web.item_sk AND p.d_date = web.d_date
            LEFT JOIN store_v1 AS store ON p.item_sk = store.item_sk AND p.d_date = store.d_date
        ) AS x
    ) AS y
    WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
    ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
    LIMIT 100
) AS limited
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
